name: Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description: follows Box Turn (forward half); a backward step on the opposite (left) foot with the same quarter turn clockwise, counts 1-2-3, feet closing on 3. Step sizes and rise are assumptions the owner accepted for now (2026-11-16), the same as the forward half mirrored backwards: 0.5 back, then the right foot lands 0.4 beyond the left in the turned frame; no rise. The whole quarter turn is placed on step 2. Measured from the facing before the turn, step 2 is 0.9 back and 0.2 left.
